parrafo.es: Papi's Restaurant On Wheels es un food truck de West Palm Beach especializado en soul food y BBQ: costillas, pollo a la parrilla, hamburguesas y un menú especial de soul food cada fin de semana. Chef Papi cocina todo fresco y también cubre catering para eventos privados.
parrafo.en: Papi's Restaurant On Wheels is a West Palm Beach food truck specialized in soul food and BBQ: ribs, grilled chicken, burgers and a special soul food menu every weekend. Chef Papi cooks everything fresh and also covers catering for private events.

hero.imagen_alt: Papi's Restaurant On Wheels food truck painted with 'Soul Food' and 'World's Best Ribs'

parrafo_1.es: Papi's Restaurant On Wheels es un food truck de soul food y BBQ que atiende West Palm Beach. Costillas a la parrilla, pollo, hamburguesas y un menú especial de soul food cada fin de semana, todo preparado el mismo día.
parrafo_1.en: Papi's Restaurant On Wheels is a soul food and BBQ food truck serving West Palm Beach. Grilled ribs, chicken, burgers and a special soul food menu every weekend, all cooked fresh the same day.

parrafo_2.es: En sus reseñas de Google, los clientes repiten lo mismo: las costillas, el mac & cheese y los collard greens son el platillo favorito, el servicio es atento y Chef Papi es un dueño que se nota que trabaja duro por su gente.
parrafo_2.en: Across their Google reviews, customers keep saying the same thing: the ribs, mac and cheese and collard greens are the favorite plate, the service is attentive, and Chef Papi is an owner who clearly works hard for his customers.

items.quote: This spot in amazing the food is on point! BABY... them collard greens mac & cheese and ribs was bussing!!! They just got a customer for life. I want to say thank you for the amazing service and food! It's worth the half hour drive. Everyone loves the food, listen go try they food you will fall in love.
Tasty tasty tasty ribs! I even got the crunchy meaty tips!!! Yummy! The sides are on point from tangy to sweet! Papi's is ready for your order, for sure! My son approved so we are going back!!

The Food here is AMAZING !!! I literally could not wait until I got home to devour my plate, my favorite dish is the Rib dinner and the delicious southern baked beans, and let's not get started on the sauces.
I can only say....bring a friend or family member. They answer the question what would Jesus do? ANSWER: Go to Papi's Soul Food & BBQ. BTW....hurry, they HUNGRY out here.
Hands down best soul food and hard working owner!! I wish I could learn a recipe or two! Y'all come show love and support!!! Food def hits the spot.
